title: Priority, preemption and backfill: urgent work, the cost of preemption, and bounded small jobs
purpose: One team queue with 32 GPUs. Four best-effort 8-GPU jobs (checkpoint every 600 s) fill it; a release job arrives. Then a 32-GPU job waits behind a 24-GPU job while an 8-GPU job with a declared 90 s runtime limit fills the gap.

steps.display: kubectl apply -f sweeps.yaml   # 4 x 8 GPUs, priority best-effort
steps.output:
job.batch/sweep-0 created
job.batch/sweep-1 created
job.batch/sweep-2 created
job.batch/sweep-3 created

steps.display: kubectl apply -f rc-eval.yaml   # 1 x 8 GPUs, priority release

steps.output:

job-sweep-3-2b8d1   10         True       <none>

steps.display: accounting: work lost to that preemption
kubectl apply -f eval-24.yaml   # 3 x 8 GPUs for 150 s
kubectl apply -f train-32.yaml   # 4 x 8 GPUs: must wait for eval-24
kubectl apply -f probe-8.yaml   # 1 x 8 GPUs, kueue.x-k8s.io/max-exec-time-seconds: 90 (it would run 1 h)
the bounded job after its limit
steps.output: {"condition": "Evicted", "reason": "DeactivatedDueToMaximumExecutionTimeExceeded", "message": "The workload is deactivated due to exceeding the maximum execution time", "active": false, "pods": {"running": 0, "pending": 0, "gpus_held": 0}}

checks.description: the release job is admitted at once by preempting one best-effort job (InClusterQueue)
the accounting service records the preempted job's work since its last checkpoint as lost
checks.because: 8 GPUs times the time since the last 600 s checkpoint boundary.

checks.description: while the 32-GPU job waits, the bounded 8-GPU job runs in the gap
checks.because: BestEffortFIFO admits a later workload that fits when the head of the queue does not.

checks.description: Kueue stops the bounded job at its declared 90 s although it would have run an hour, so it cannot delay the big job
checks.because: kueue.x-k8s.io/max-exec-time-seconds: the workload is deactivated when its admitted time passes the limit.

checks.description: the 32-GPU job starts when the 24-GPU job finishes
checks.because: Its whole request fits once eval-24's quota is released.
